name: Rick Sinclair
description: The patriarch of CFC. Father of Jamie and Merrick Sinclair. Father-in-law of Daniel Paladin. His family network effectively governs the organization. JD's father John Sr. is still a deacon under his tenure. Present as an institutional force more than a direct relationship.
bio: Head pastor of CFC across all campuses. Nine children. Led the August 2018 discovery meeting in the pastoral authority role. Casually mentioned in that meeting that he imagined in five years the situation would no longer be of concern. JD thought it was unreasonable at the time. Five years passed.
